'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[Lukoil]] [[oil refinery]] in [[Volgograd Oblast]], [[Russia]], is attacked by [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] long-range drones, causing a large fire and disrupting operations. [[Governor of Volgograd Oblast|Volgograd governor]] [[Andrey Bocharov]] says that the attack was repelled by [[anti-aircraft warfare|air defences]]. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/27558 (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***At least 28 [[civilian]]s are killed by [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] shelling in Russian-occupied [[Lysychansk]], [[Luhansk Oblast]], according to Russian-appointed local officials. The officials added that ten others were rescued after being trapped under rubble. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-lysychansk-bakery-shelling-war-61ce6fc809bd73ac0fa994e8b7e84286 (AP)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[2024 missile strikes in Yemen]]
***The [[United States]] and [[United Kingdom]] launch [[airstrike]]s against 36 [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] targets in [[Yemen]], including underground weapons storage facilities, [[missile]] systems, radars, and [[command and control]] centres. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-carrying-out-new-strikes-yemen-us-officials-say-2024-02-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Chile wildfires]]
**[[Chile]] declares a [[state of emergency]] as [[wildfire]]s kill at least 51 people across the country, while hundreds more are reported missing. Multiple fires have been reported in [[Valparaíso]] and [[Viña del Mar]]. More than 1,100 buildings are destroyed. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/raging-forest-fires-kill-least-19-chile-toll-expected-rise-2024-02-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[2024 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] wins the [[2024 South Carolina Democratic presidential primary]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2024-primary-elections/south-carolina-president-results (NBC News)]
*[[2024 Northern Ireland Executive formation]]
**In a [[power sharing]] deal, [[Michelle O'Neill]] becomes the [[First Minister of Northern Ireland]], marking the first time that the position is held by an [[Irish nationalism|Irish nationalist]], while the [[Democratic Unionist Party]]'s [[Emma Little-Pengelly]] becomes deputy first minister. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-politics-68180505 (BBC News)]
